name: project-nomad
description: Project NOMAD - an offline-first knowledge and education server.

scripts.deploy: docker compose --env-file .env -f install/management_compose.yaml build && docker compose --env-file .env -f install/management_compose.yaml up -d
scripts.migrate: docker compose --env-file .env -f install/management_compose.yaml exec admin node ace migration:run
scripts.migrate:fresh: docker compose --env-file .env -f install/management_compose.yaml exec admin node ace migration:fresh
scripts.migrate:rollback: docker compose --env-file .env -f install/management_compose.yaml exec admin node ace migration:rollback

author: Crosstalk Solutions, LLC
